body:
Founder real-time, direct correction of the earlier S479-follow-up door-composition work: 'i still dont know how to add a door - there is the ability to make a cube a door but its not clear how to then make that work in the world i keep asking for an actual object viewer i dont want to make doors be levels please - make widget or something hey are both objects but widgets just dont show up in the levels menu and the geometry of the widget shows up not the geometry of the underlying level under the widget - there should be no ground plane and no dimension in the widget - a level is a dimension - a widget is just a widget.' New shankpit_widgets table + WidgetStore (real CRUD, mirroring LevelStore's shape but deliberately minimal -- walls+doors only, no width/height/depth, no ground plane, no spawners/nav nodes/characters/level exits/next_level_id/story flags, and no Objects of its own -- a real, separate table, not a flag on shankpit_levels, precisely because a Widget is not a Level). LevelObject gains RefWidgetID (0=unset, same convention RefLevelID already uses) -- exactly one of RefLevelID/RefWidgetID ever set, enforced in validateObjects with a new test. flattenObjects gains a widget branch composing a widget's walls/doors into the parent's export via the exact same transform math a level-referencing object already uses, but never recurses (a widget has no Objects of its own, real v0 scope limit). New TestExport_ComposedWidgetObject verifies both walls and a door survive composition with correct final positions/box_index. New admin-CRUD-only handler + main.go wiring -- no public registry endpoint, a widget is never independently fetched by the native client. Frontend: new standalone 'SHANKPIT Widgets' NOCK tab (not the Levels menu) with its own smaller 3D editor reusing WallInspector/CameraState/cameraPositionFrom exported directly from ShankpitLevelEditor.tsx rather than forked; the level editor's own Objects panel gains a real, separate widget picker alongside the existing level picker; placed widget objects render their ACTUAL geometry with zero wireframe bounding box (a widget has no dimension to size one from) -- this is the real 'object viewer' the founder kept asking for, delivered for the one case (widgets) that structurally needed it most. go build/test ./... clean (full suite, 8 new widget tests + 2 new composition/validation tests). npx tsc -b shows only the pre-existing unrelated goldenband.ts error; npx vite build clean. Deployed live: iduna.service restarted, migration confirmed applied (shankpit_widgets table exists in the live DB), admin endpoint reachable (401 without auth as expected). Commits: 45f7051 (backend), 3df80b4 (frontend), 24f12ef (dist), 0f2b4e3 (changelog).

⚓ ☃
title: S482: real Widgets -- reusable geometry+doors, a real, separate registry from Levels
